name: Exp_GStopLoss
summary: Exp_GStopLoss is a utility Expert Advisor that manages stop loss levels for open positions, likely implementing a global or trailing stop loss mechanism. It does not open trades on its own but instead modifies existing positions' stop loss to protect profits or limit losses. The EA monitors all open positions and adjusts their SL according to configurable rules.
summary_zh: Exp_GStopLoss是一个工具类EA，用于管理持仓的止损水平，可能实现全局止损或追踪止损功能。它不自行开仓，而是根据可配置规则修改已有持仓的止损以保护利润或限制亏损。该EA监控所有持仓并按规则调整止损。
strategy_analysis: 该EA属于止损管理工具，不具备自主开仓的策略逻辑。其核心功能是监控账户中所有持仓的止损水平，并根据价格走势动态调整止损位。入场条件不适用，因为它不自行开仓；出场条件通过调整止损间接实现，当价格回撤触及调整后的止损时平仓。仓位管理不涉及，资金管理方面可能包含按点数或百分比设置止损的参数。该工具通常支持对所有品种或指定品种的持仓进行止损调整，并可能包含追踪止损功能，即随着盈利增加将止损逐步向有利方向移动。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a stop loss management tool and does not have its own trade entry strategy logic. Its core function is to monitor stop loss levels for all open positions in the account and dynamically adjust them based on price movement. Entry conditions are not applicable since it does not open trades on its own; exit conditions are indirectly achieved by adjusting stop loss, closing positions when price retraces to the adjusted stop level. Position sizing is not involved, and money management may include parameters for setting stop loss by pips or percentage. The tool typically supports stop loss adjustment for positions across all symbols or specified symbols, and may include trailing stop functionality that gradually moves the stop loss in the favorable direction as profit increases.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points or amount

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 指定持仓的魔术编号，0表示所有持仓
parameters.description_en: Magic number for positions, 0 means all positions

parameters.name: ApplyToAllSymbols
parameters.description: 是否应用于所有交易品种

pros: 自动化止损管理，减少人工干预需求
追踪止损功能可锁定浮动利润
支持多品种统一管理，提高账户整体风险控制效率
pros_en: Automated stop loss management reduces need for manual intervention
Trailing stop function locks in floating profits
Multi-symbol unified management improves overall account risk control efficiency
cons: 无法自主开仓，依赖其他策略或手动交易产生持仓
止损调整可能在剧烈行情中出现滑点导致实际止损与设定不符
如果参数设置不当，追踪止损可能过于紧密导致频繁被扫止损
cons_en: Cannot open positions independently, relies on other strategies or manual trading to generate positions
Stop loss adjustments may experience slippage during volatile markets causing discrepancy between actual and set stops
Improper parameter settings for trailing stop may be too tight, causing frequent stop-outs
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损计算，适应市场波动性变化
添加可视化面板显示当前各持仓的止损状态和调整历史
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss calculation to adapt to market volatility changes
Add a visual dashboard showing current stop loss status and adjustment history for each position

risk_points: 止损调整依赖于经纪商的执行质量，极端行情可能无法及时修改
如果EA意外停止运行，持仓可能失去止损保护
risk_points_en: Stop loss adjustments depend on broker execution quality; extreme market conditions may prevent timely modifications
If the EA stops running unexpectedly, positions may lose stop loss protection
